focused_r2.name: Self-consistent internal polarization under a passive capacitive load
focused_r2.physical_change: Replace ideal zero-voltage termination in some preparations by a known isolated external capacitor. The electrode nodes can redistribute charge between their crystal and load faces, but each whole node has fixed zero net free charge. The resulting depolarizing field acts on the internal offset. The old passer's zero-field constitutive state is no longer the equilibrium, even though its moving-electrode reasoning remains necessary and is retained in the new source.
apparatus: Retain the r1 neutral-cell termination, homogeneous prescribed F, three-component internal offset and strictly convex zero-macroscopic-field free energy W0(s,F). The fixed background has a known positive scalar absolute permittivity epsilon, constant in the laboratory and independent of strain. W0 includes microscopic electrostatics at zero macroscopic field; the background field energy added by finite loading is not already included.

There are S fixed reference lateral cells and N cells through the slab, with reference area S*a0^2. Ideal electrodes follow the third-direction material faces. Lateral periodicity removes fringing; no mobile carriers, surface layer or extra circuit capacitance. The load capacitor is mechanically separate and fixed while F changes.

In loaded mode the top crystal electrode and top load face form one insulated metallic node, and the bottom faces form the other. Each node has total free charge zero; charge may move within a node. Each specimen is equilibrated at the specified F after connection. An ideal zero-impedance amplifier in the crystal top lead measures conventional current into that electrode, not current supplied by a voltage source. There is no leakage, electrical inertia, imposed voltage or thermal offset fluctuation.

A separate ideal-short mode clamps the electrode voltage to zero and reproduces r1. For each preparation take macroscopic size with the dimensionless load fixed, then the small deformation amplitude limit, then the quasistatic frequency limit after charge and offset equilibration. Use the same signed current coefficient and fixed reference-area normalization as r1.

units_and_size_scaling.fixed_scales: q0 is positive charge, a0 length, E0 energy. epsilon has units F/m. Choose the known dimensionless electrical coupling g=q0^2/(epsilon*a0*E0)=1; K remains the sole unknown in[.8,1.2].
units_and_size_scaling.capacitance: C0=epsilon*a0*S/N is the undeformed background slab capacitance. Cb(F)=C0*c(F), c(F)=det(F)*|F^(-T)e3|^2. The known load is CL=C0*cL, with cL in[.5,2] as a proposed domain. CL is constant during an individual mechanical drive; c(F) changes.
units_and_size_scaling.thermodynamic_limit: Keep cL=CL*N/(epsilon*a0*S) fixed as the macroscopic-thickness/area limit is taken. A load held numerically fixed while N grows would instead approach a short circuit and erase the intended effect. The public apparatus must specify this scaling.
units_and_size_scaling.charge: q=Qcrystal_top/(q0*S). The connected load top face has charge-Qcrystal_top. Current per reference area is(q0/a0^2)*q_dot.

private_derivation.energy: U/(N*S*E0)=W0(s,F)/E0 + (g/2)*[(q-s3)^2/c(F)+q^2/cL]. The first field term vanishes at the r1 zero-field electrode charge q=s3. Both capacitor terms are positive.
private_derivation.units_check: Qcrystal_top^2/(C0*N*S*E0)=g*q^2; thus the displayed energy is intensive and dimensionless. The planar gap is N*a0/|F^(-T)e3|, the actual face area is S*a0^2*det(F)*|F^(-T)e3|, giving the stated Cb.
private_derivation.elimination: Minimizing over electrode charge gives q=cL*s3/(c+cL). The reduced internal energy is W0/E0+g*s3^2/[2(c+cL)]. With x=s-S0 and r=g/(c+cL), equilibrium is K*x+4|x|^2*x-h(F)+r*s3*e3=0.
private_derivation.sign_and_readout: The positive added curvature stiffens the polar internal mode. For the drive derivative, c_prime is included in both controls. q_prime=p*s3_prime+p_prime*s3, with p=cL/(c+cL) and p_prime=-cL*c_prime/(c+cL)^2. The physical state derivative solves [H0+r*e3*e3^T]s_prime=h_prime-r_prime*s3*e3, r_prime=-g*c_prime/(c+cL)^2.
private_derivation.uniqueness: H0 has eigenvalues at least K>.0. The reduced electrostatic term is positive semidefinite and the joint q,s energy is strictly convex for finite positive c and cL. No new metastable branch is introduced.
private_derivation.charge_centers: For the old upper-triangular F box, conservative bounds are|h1|<=.05376, |h2|<=.04392, -.177<=h3<=.21012. Components1,2 obey|x1|<=.0672 and|x2|<=.0549. Writing D=K+4|x|^2, s3=(D*.22+h3)/(D+r), so-.00125<=s3<=.48265 for r>=0,D>=.8. Thus c+s remains inside the same material cell: its third coordinate lies in[.19875,.68265]. These are algebraic bounds, not a numerical domain sweep.

focused_r2.completed_wrong_closure: First compute the exact r1 zero-field internal equilibrium and tangent; then apply the exact moving-electrode load-charge formula and its full geometry derivative. This is a one-way piezoelectric-source approximation: the circuit responds to the relaxed polarization but its macroscopic field does not feed back on that offset. It is the leading weak-electrical-backaction limit g->0, exact for ideal short circuit at any g. It uses every finite-load input through the capacitor divider and is not an unused-control or missing-current-factor implementation. At the proposed fixed g=1 it is physically inappropriate, not an alternative exact equilibrium of the stated apparatus.
focused_r2.calibration: Use the r1 ideal-short longitudinal stretches and both drive signs. q=s3 and the field energy vanishes exactly, so physical and source calibration coincide for every K. The existing monotonicity proof .7*l/(K+12*x3^2) identifies K throughout[.8,1.2]. Fixed instrument sigma.001 can remain unchanged and independent of K; no finite-load data are needed to identify K. Actual noise fits have not been rerun for a new package.

analytic_discriminator.setting: F=I, G33=1 with all other G entries zero, cL=g=1; same current coefficient as r1. No cancellation or zero source response is used.
analytic_discriminator.bounds: For every K in[.8,1.2], j_physical>.5*.645/1.786+.25*(.22-11/130)>.21. Also j_physical<.35/(K+.5)+.055, hence j_source-j_physical>.175/[K*(K+.5)]>=.175/2.04. Since j_source<=.4925, the relative gap against either positive source or physical signal exceeds17%. These conservative inequalities are an analytic check only; there is no sampled sweep or graded-group margin claim.
analytic_discriminator.future_group_scope: Continuity permits a neighborhood of this ordinary loaded longitudinal preparation, but no concrete multi-setting neighborhood bounds or group scores have been validated. focused_r2.independent_reference_route: Use the actual planar electrostatic boundary-value problem with uniform bulk polarization, passive background epsilon and two conductor potentials, coupled to the separate load-capacitor charge relation and the three internal stationarity equations. Solve the joint field/charge/state system without eliminating q into the source/oracle divider; difference the total top-electrode free charge at neighboring F. Microscopic zero-field energy must not be added again. Compare this charge/field solve with the reduced-energy Hessian oracle. This route is proposed, not implemented or independently converged.
